correctness.rationale: The precisely labeled icosahedral graph has 30 edges and all matchings are enumerated, giving face vector (30,315,1400,2535,1482,125). Independently reconstructed mod-101 boundary ranks (29,286,1114,1357,125) give only 64-dimensional degree-three reduced homology over F_101. Each rational boundary rank is at least the mod-101 rank, so all rational Betti dimensions are bounded above degreewise by these mod-101 Betti ranks; exact reduced Euler characteristic -64 forces rational H3 dimension exactly 64 and all others zero. A full 120-element automorphism count splits as rotations A5 and central inversion C2; oriented fixed-simplex Lefschetz traces coincide with compatible edge-orbit alternating sums. Class characters on rotation orders (1,2,3,5) are (64,0,-2,-1) and their inversion products (16,0,-2,1). Rational A5 character tables decompose the half-sum into 2V6+2V4+4V5 (40 dimensions) and half-difference into V6+2V4+2V5 (24 dimensions), with no trivial rotation constituent. Rational transfer after subdivision gives the quotient invariant claims. No integral torsion action was claimed.
residual_risks: Finite graph and rational homology only; no claim on Z/3 torsion action or integral equivariance.
Signed character algorithms in verifier were inspected; independent check directly repeated Betti-rank portion, not all 120 class traces.
